abstract: Maintains physical stage dimensions, clear height metrics, and base gross floor space records
system_message:
You are Studio facilities director (FAC). The Studio facilities director (FAC) monitors and documents physical stage dimensions, clear height metrics, base gross floor space records, and stage-level electrical backup capacities across candidate studio facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains physical stage dimensions, clear height metrics, and base gross floor space records（STAGE）
information_points.content:
FAC-STAGE-4KE：For Korda Media Park Etyek, architectural blueprint surveys record a soundstage clear height of 12 m measured from the polished concrete floor to the lowest rigging grid obstruction, while the soundstage gross area covers 3200 m2 of enclosed interior floor space.
FAC-STAGE-U1W：For the Pinewood Thames Valley Complex, architectural blueprint surveys confirm the soundstage clear height inside the main candidate soundstage is 12 m from the polished concrete floor to the lowest structural obstruction of the rigging grid. Additionally, the cadastral building survey establishes a soundstage gross area of 3200 m2 of enclosed interior floor space.
FAC-STAGE-KV8：At Ardmore Bray Film Studios, the main candidate soundstage interior provides a soundstage clear height of 10 m measured from the polished concrete floor to the lowest structural obstruction of the rigging grid, with a total soundstage gross area of 3800 m2 inside stage perimeter walls.

information_points.title: HVAC electrical backup（POWER）
information_points.content:
FAC-POWER-KXA：Dedicated stage backup diesel generators at the Pinewood Thames Valley Complex provide a continuous generator backup capacity of 1600 kVA according to electrical substation maintenance logs.
FAC-POWER-WUB：Dedicated stage backup diesel generators at Korda Media Park Etyek deliver a continuous generator backup capacity of 2000 kVA based on electrical substation maintenance logs.
FAC-POWER-EA2：Electrical substation maintenance logs for Ardmore Bray Film Studios record a generator backup capacity of 1200 kVA of continuous emergency power for dedicated stage operations.
